// What a tool's input may name, checked before it reaches a command line.
export const CONTEXT = /^[-._:@/a-zA-Z0-9]{1,253}$/
export const DNS_NAME = /^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]{0,251}[a-z0-9])?$/
export const SECRET_KEY = /^[-._a-zA-Z0-9]{1,253}$/
export const REPO = /^[\w.-]+\/[\w.-]+$/

{
  "name": "infra-guard",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "Guards infra work from Claude Code: shows the ambient kube/gcloud/gh/aws targets, requires named contexts and approved terraform plans, reads scripts before they run, keeps Secret values from the model, logs changes and watches rollouts.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jerry Chuang",
    "url": "https://github.com/dfgh012316"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/dfgh012316/infra-guard",
  "repository": "https://github.com/dfgh012316/infra-guard",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "kubernetes",
    "kubectl",
    "helm",
    "terraform",
    "secrets",
    "devops",
    "sre",
    "guardrails"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "prodPattern": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Production pattern",
      "description": "Regular expression; a target name that matches is shown as production",
      "default": "prod|prd|production"
    }
  }
}
